root_cause_confirmed: The implementer's published root cause was INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED, not accepted. At c0c1958 the debt section's separator line is |---|---|---| and `grep -c '^| '` returns 89 while `grep -c '^|'` returns 90 -- the separator is in the second count only. Minus-two reproduces every withdrawn figure exactly (87/91/91/94); minus-one gives the correct 88/92/92/95. So the derivation, not the transcription, was the bug, and it was uniformly one low -- which is why re-deriving alone would not have caught it across four recurrences.
